title: Design exercise: SAA-1.3-S03
scenario: Fernhill Public Library Network serves 90,000 members through a public catalog site delivered by a content delivery network and a members-only API on a regional load balancer in eu-west-1, both under its own domain. The certificates were bought from a commercial authority and uploaded by hand; one expired unnoticed in March and both endpoints were down for three hours. IT is one person who wants renewal to need no action at all, and the domain's DNS records are managed in the same AWS account. Traffic between browsers and both endpoints must stay encrypted, with no new certificate purchases.
constraints: Do not claim live AWS experience
IT is a single person and must never need to track an expiry date
Finance will not fund certificate purchases beyond existing AWS usage charges

rubric.label: Certificates are requested in the Region each endpoint requires, with the delivery-network certificate and the API certificate placed correctly
No imported or hand-uploaded certificate remains in the renewal path

constraint_reason: Mapped as design_exercise to complete skill coverage when no dedicated live lab step exists
